Internal AI Marketing Team

Built & Used In-House
24/7 monitoring across all client accounts

We built our own AI-powered marketing team and run it continuously across CloudZoom client accounts. It's a coordinated set of AI agents — one tracks search rankings and SEO health, one monitors online reviews and brand mentions, one analyzes competitor positioning. They report into a unified dashboard and generate weekly strategy briefs automatically, surfacing issues and opportunities without anyone having to manually check. We use our own OpenClaw platform to orchestrate the agents. It's the same system we offer to clients.
